faq.label: How does the ₹500 membership work?
faq.body: A one-time ₹500 activates your Farm Club membership and includes a complimentary welcome basket of seasonal vegetables. Membership is required before you can lease a plot.

faq.label: What is included in a plot subscription?
faq.body: Your annual plan covers dedicated plot farming, weekly produce boxes, and live plot tracking. A flat ₹10,000 delivery charge covers doorstep delivery across Tamil Nadu.

faq.label: Can I cancel a weekly delivery?
faq.body: Yes — deliveries two or more weeks out can be cancelled. The next two delivery slots are locked because produce is already being harvested.

faq.label: How does renewal billing work?
faq.body: Billing is manual. At the end of your plan year we generate a renewal bill. You pay it to continue weekly deliveries — there is no auto-charge.
